title: The Ravens Feed Elijah
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops to wonder at small things, and tonight Elijah is fed by birds by a quiet brook: Wren finds a forgotten lunch made up by a friend’s half sandwich and wonders who sent it.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Wren stops to wonder at small things, and Elijah’s help came on the wings of ordinary black birds. In Wren’s world today: the lunch box is left at home and Wren’s tummy starts to worry. Then a friend slides half a sandwich across the table. Wren looks at it and wonders who sent it. She whispers thank you to Heavenly Father in her heart. Just like Elijah, Wren learned that Heavenly Father sends help in surprising ways.
